title: Restricted stage Mayer--Vietoris diagrams before colimit exactness and continuity
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U,V\subseteq X$ quasi-compact opens [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].  Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(T,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(T_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix $p\ge0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Fix an index $i_0\in I$ and an isomorphism $\epsilon:D_{i_0}\cong (U\cup V)$. Put $g=f_{i_0}$ followed by $\epsilon$ and the inclusion $U\cup V\to X$, and let $W_U=g^{-1}(U)$ and $W_V=g^{-1}(V)$. Put $Q=\varinjlim_I H_i$, with its canonical comparison $m:Q\to B_{\mathrm{pt}}$ induced by the cocone $B$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Put $B_4=H^p(W_U,L|_{W_U})\times H^p(W_V,L|_{W_V})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and let $r':B_{\mathrm{pt}}\to B_4$ be the pair of canonical restriction maps after $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$. There exist a nonempty directed preorder J; four functors K1,K2,K3,K4:J→Ab; natural transformations a:K1→K2, b:K2→K3, r:K3→K4; an isomorphism eQ:colim K3→Q; groups B1,B2; maps a':B1→B2, b':B2→B.pt; and comparisons v1:colim K1→B1, v2:colim K2→B2, v4:colim K4→B4. At every j, (a_j,b_j) and (b_j,r_j) are exact, and (a',b') is exact. Each v has a stage-cohomology comparison certificate [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison] for the predicate S=U or S=V or S=U∩V. The three squares commute: v2 colim(a)=a'v1, m eQ colim(b)=b'v2, and v4 colim(r) eQ^{-1}=r'm. This is a construction of stage diagrams and their canonical neighboring comparisons with no continuity hypotheses. It asserts neither exactness of the colimit pairs nor surjectivity or injectivity of their neighboring maps.

proof.text: Split p into zero and successor. At zero obtain the final restriction row, construct the two constant zero functors, take bottom groups to be their colimits, and use identity-isomorphism certificates. The colimit of the constant zero functor is zero by isColimitConstCocone. Stage injectivity gives exactness of zero followed by r; all zero squares and other exact pairs follow directly. At successor obtain the native Mayer--Vietoris cocone segment.

Use Functor.Final.colimitIso for eQ. Descend each stage-leg square using colimit.hom_ext, ι_colimMap and ι_desc. For the middle square use the formula for the coprojections followed by eQ.hom. For the last square first prove the equality on the tail colimit, then precompose by eQ.inv and cancel the inverse-hom pair. Evaluate the resulting morphism equalities on elements to obtain precisely the statement’s three squares.
